title: Deformations of mixed associators in module categories
summary: We set up a cochain complex $C^\bullet_{\mathrm{mix}}(\mathcal{M})$ whose cohomology controls deformations of the mixed associator of a module category $\mathcal{M}$ over a $\Bbbk$-linear monoidal category $\mathcal{C}$. We show that $C^\bullet_{\mathrm{mix}}(\mathcal{M})$ is isomorphic to the Davydov-Yetter (DY) complex of the representation functor $ρ: \mathcal{C} \to \mathrm{End}(\mathcal{M})$.
